name: CoderPress Integration for NOWPayments with Gravity Forms
author: CoderPress

sections.description:
CoderPress Integration for NOWPayments with Gravity Forms lets you accept cryptocurrency payments directly through your Gravity Forms using the NOWPayments gateway.

Perfect for businesses selling digital products, services, memberships, consultations, and more.

Accept payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, Litecoin, Solana, and many others.

Free Version Features

  • Accept one-time crypto payments in Gravity Forms
  • Redirect users to secure NOWPayments hosted checkout
  • Sandbox mode for payment testing
  • Supports Products & Services transaction types
  • Secure IPN/Webhook handling with HMAC verification
  • Supports 300+ cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments
  • Easy feed-based Gravity Forms integration

Pro Features

Upgrade to Pro for advanced recurring payment capabilities:

  • Recurring crypto subscriptions
  • Subscription billing management
  • Advanced subscription intervals
  • Automatic recurring renewals
  • Priority support
  • Future premium enhancements

Get Pro:
https://coderpress.co/products/nowpayments-for-gravity-forms/?utm_source=wordpress-org&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=nowpayments-gf-pro-features

Upgrade to Pro

Unlock recurring crypto subscriptions, advanced billing controls, and premium features with Pro:
https://coderpress.co/products/nowpayments-for-gravity-forms/?utm_source=wordpress-org&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=nowpayments-gf-pro-top

Who Is This Plugin For?

This plugin is ideal for:

  • SaaS businesses accepting crypto payments
  • Membership and subscription websites
  • Agencies selling services online
  • Digital product creators
  • Course creators using Gravity Forms
  • Donation / fundraising websites
  • Crypto-native businesses

How It Works

  1. Customer fills out your Gravity Form
  2. Plugin sends payment data securely to NOWPayments
  3. Customer is redirected to hosted crypto checkout
  4. Customer completes payment in selected cryptocurrency
  5. Payment status is updated automatically via webhook/IPN

External services

This plugin connects to the NOWPayments API to process cryptocurrency payments.

It sends payment/order details to NOWPayments when checkout is initiated.

Service Provider: NOWPayments Ltd.

  • Website: https://nowpayments.io
  • Terms of Service: https://nowpayments.io/doc/fd-tos.pdf
  • Privacy Policy: https://nowpayments.io/doc/fd-privacy-policy.pdf
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Gravity Forms
  2. Upload plugin to /wp-content/plugins/nowpayments-for-gravity-forms
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Navigate to Forms → Settings → NOWPayments
  5. Enter API credentials and IPN Secret
  6. Configure Sandbox or Live Mode
  7. Add a NOWPayments feed to your form
sections.faq:
Does this support subscriptions?

Subscriptions are available in the Pro version only.

Which cryptocurrencies are supported?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies including BTC, ETH, LTC, USDT, SOL, and more.

Does checkout happen on my website?

No. Customers are redirected to secure NOWPayments hosted checkout.

Can I test payments before going live?

Yes. Sandbox mode is included in the free version.
